segments.name: sports school business
segments.description: Runs children's sports schools and classes with full-time coaches, using public and private facilities.
segments.evidence: Our growth in school club support services stems from our decade-long expertise in the sports school business, establishing us as a pioneering player in extracurricular activities outsourcing business.

segments.name: social business
segments.description: Provides school club support and related services to municipalities and government authorities, won through public bidding.
segments.evidence: In our social business, we provide services to municipalities as well as other governmental authorities, such as the Japan Sports Agency.

revenueModel.text: Municipalities and government authorities pay for social business services such as school club support; families pay for children's sports school classes.
revenueModel.evidence: In our social business, we provide services to municipalities as well as other governmental authorities, such as the Japan Sports Agency.

changes.text: In 2025 the company moved from a single reportable segment to a two-segment structure.
changes.evidence: Effective January 1, 2025, management transitioned to a two-segment structure to reflect organizational changes.
